name: dagrail
description: Govern long-running multi-agent DAGs without keeping lifecycle state in chat.

interface.shortDescription: Keep agent DAGs recoverable, bounded, and auditable.
interface.longDescription: DAGrail keeps graph revisions, role leases, checkpoints, allowed actions, external-effect receipts, and compact context outside chat while the LLM remains in control.
defaultPrompt: Inspect the DAG frontier and advance it safely.
Resume my assigned node from its durable checkpoint.
